name: fluidd
title: Fluidd
author: bespoked
description: Swaps SM's outdated Fluidd for the current upstream release. You get input-shaper graphs, integrated config/G-code editors, tool-colour preview, modern mesh viz. Uninstall reverts to the SM-shipped copy automatically via overlayfs; no nginx config touched. Bleeding-edge build: adds the AFC "Toolchanger Eject Mode" toggle (Eject docks the mounted tool on a toolchanger).
tagline: Modern Fluidd v1.37.0: replaces the stock SM build.

variables.name: FLUIDD_PORT
variables.description: HTTP port Fluidd is served on. Auto-assigned; the primary UI uses 80.

config.label: Fluidd port
config.hint: Auto-assigned. Make Fluidd primary to serve it on port 80.
